text:
devon: Heads-up — after today's CNI rollout (cilium 1.24) we started seeing sporadic east-west tail latency and small-packet drops impacting GPU training pods in west2. p50 ok, p99 ~250-400ms. Anyone else seeing this?

alex: saw it too. interestingly only pods with hostNetwork:false and geneve encapsulation. hostNetwork:true unaffected.
mira: confirmed on my side. tcpdump on node shows probes being fragmented and rerouted to mgmt NIC intermittently.
devon: example tcpdump snippet I grabbed: ```12:34:56.789 IP 10.0.3.45 > 10.0.4.12: UDP, length 1400``` then next packet a few ms later from host IP, same src/dst but offload flags weird.
samir: could be qdisc/qos change in 1.24? there was a patch that reorders skb priorities when encapsulating with GENEVE.
alex: checked kernels: eBPF offload + tx-checksum offload combo seems to flip TOS on encapsulation. that breaks our tc rules that were matching on tos/prio.
mira: steps I ran: `kubectl get pods -o wide` -> reproduce on node gpu-node-11. `ethtool -k eth0` shows gso/gro on. `tc -s qdisc show dev eth0` shows fq_codel + ingress policer on host NIC.
devon: temporary mitigation that helped: disabled offload on eth0 on one node `ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off` — pod traffic latency normalized for a few runs. obviously not a cluster-wide fix.
samir: filing a cilium issue? we should capture packet captures and kernel stack traces. also check rdma link resets — gpu pods using ibverbs saw connection churn earlier.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: cilium/1.24 rolled to west2 (canary=100%).
sre-oncall: Reverting to 1.23 in west2 now for canary nodes. rolling rollback in progress, ETA ~30m.
alex: note: our prefix-KV caching means many requests are short probes — small UDP/TCP acks are sensitive to MTU and fragmentation. If encapsulation increases overhead and qos mapping changes, we see out-of-order/sawtooth latency.
mira: I also saw RDMA MAD timeouts on two hosts around 12:40, logs: `ibportstate: down -> initializing` followed by `GID table update failed` — might be related.
devon: next steps: 1) collect `tcpdump -i any -w /tmp/cilium-probe.pcap` on affected nodes 2) collect `tc qdisc` and `ethtool -k` outputs 3) kernel dmesg for offload warnings 4) verify cilium bpffs version and recent PRs about qos.
samir: I've opened infra ticket INFRA-2456 with logs + pcap. tagging security: no sensitive data.
alex: long-term let's add a presubmit e2e with host NIC qos + encapsulation matrix to catch this. also consider pinning a calico/cilium compatibility matrix per kernel driver.
mira: can we patch cilium config: `encapsulation: geneve; tunnelMTU: 1440; qosEnabled: false` as an interim for west2? might drop perf but reduce packet rewrite.
sre-oncall: applying config change to canary pool with 10% of nodes now. monitoring dashboards (p99 latency, packet drops) updated.
devon: thanks — will keep collecting traces. if rollback finishes we should baseline pre/post metrics. :thumbsup:
